subject: Download Link to Amber20 for Project Compatibility

messages.author: Sharawy, Mahmoud
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
I am reaching out to inquire about obtaining Amber20 for some specific project needs. I noticed that the primary download page currently features Amber22, and I need the earlier version due to compatibility requirements with certain projects.
If there is a recommended approach or an official alternative source for downloading amber20.tar.bz2, I would be very appreciative of that guidance. Understanding the need to maintain software consistency across projects, I hope to align my environment with the required version.
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
MS
